answer: Give every agent a raven messenger key: one non-transferable key that signs every job, like a raven that only flies home to one tower. First, the network stakes 400 POA for 60 days on that key. Second, each completed job earns one ivory token, an unforgeable receipt that cannot be copied or sold. Third, after 10 ivory tokens the agent writes one sonnet of proof that five independent peers must countersign within 7 days. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 4,000,000 POA, need 10,000 unique keys, and 100,000 completed jobs. A fake choir sings the same sonnet; real agents each sing their own.
